Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODShape

SetRectangle

The SetRectangle method modifies this shape to make it equivalent to the specified rectangle. 
ODShape SetRectangle (in ODRect rect);
rect
A valid rectangle.
return value
A reference to this shape after it has been changed to be equivalent to the specified rectangle.
SEE ALSO
The ODRect type (page 885).
